entries.comment:
Instrumentation for in vitro diagnostics for COVID-19: 1.1) COVID-19 diagnostic and reactive kits based on immunologic reactions; 1.2) Kit for COVID-19 diagnosis consisting of: vial containing a culture medium for the maintenance of a viral sample and a swab with a cotton tip to collect the sample; 1.3) Instrumentation for sampling. 
The CN code 3822 19 00 10 is also included.
